basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | jrf (gate): B.Tech in Mechanical Engg. Candidate must qualify any one of the following: 1. Scholars selected through National Eligibility Test - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or GATE. 2. The selection process through National Level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOs, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IISc, IISCR etc. (The candidates should have expertise in running direct simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) codes and have sufficient knowledge in rarefied gas dynamics.)

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 44400 (Pay: Rs. 37000 + HRA: Rs. 7400 + Medical: Rs. 0)
salary_details.jrf (gate): Pay Recommended: Rs. 37,000 | HRA: Rs. 7,400 | Medical: Rs. 0 | Total Amount: Rs. 44,400 per month

selection_process: The selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the online interview.
how_to_apply: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati.
Carefully follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal.

Search for the project title "Computational Study of Lunar Regolith Erosion by Lander Engine Exhaust using 3D MPI-parallelized NS-DSMC framework" or advertisement number 2627R-0428-MECH1319TAKR to access the relevant position.
Submit the online application before 5:00 PM on 11 October 2026.
Keep a copy of the application for future reference.
important_instructions: No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the test and interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed via E-mail on 11 October 2026 (Sunday). Candidates are required to appear for the online interview on 12 October 2026 at 3:00 PM. For technical assistance related to the online application process, candidates may email to [email protected]. For any clarification, contact Principal Investigator Tapan Krishnakumar Mankodi at [email protected].

content_sections.text: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the JRF (GATE) post under the project titled "Computational Study of Lunar Regolith Erosion by Lander Engine Exhaust using 3D MPI-parallelized NS-DSMC framework" in the Department of Mechanical Engineering.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this post?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati), Research and Development Section.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIT Guwahati JRF (GATE) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the JRF (GATE) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 11 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering and must have qualified CSIR-UGC NET, GATE, or National Level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies, along with expertise in running DSMC codes and rarefied gas dynamics.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total monthly amount payable for the JRF (GATE) post?
faq.answer: The total amount payable is Rs. 44,400 per month (Pay of Rs. 37,000 plus HRA of Rs. 7,400).

faq.question: Q6. When is the online interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The online interview is scheduled on 12 October 2026 (Monday) at 3:00 PM.

faq.question: Q7. How will shortlisted candidates be notified?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed via E-mail on 11 October 2026 (Sunday).

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the appointment?
faq.answer: The duration of the appointment is 4 months.
